BehaviorTree._description: Save the calibration_01, calibration_02, ... waypoints for the reBot wrist camera calibrations by tilting the arm around a point on the board. Jog the arm first so the wrist camera sees the whole board; the views ring around that pose. See https://docs.picknik.ai/how_to/robotics_applications/camera_calibration/.

SubTree.input_port: Distance in meters from link6 along its approach axis to the board point the views tilt around; about the camera-to-board distance.
